data.name: Fatima
data.gender_notes: Fatima is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who weans; one who abstains
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ف-ط-م (f-ṭ-m), 'to wean, to separate'. Fāṭima means 'one who weans' or 'one who abstains'. Its root is ف-ط-م (f-ṭ-m). Borne by Fāṭima al-Zahrāʾ, daughter of the Prophet ﷺ. Fatima is a Arabic name meaning “One who weans; one who abstains”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fatima expresses “One who weans; one who abstains”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ف-ط-م (f-ṭ-m), 'to wean, to separate'. Fāṭima means 'one who weans' or 'one who abstains'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fatima total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
